Add a question and choose Long text for a paragraph.

![SurveyStudio's Design screen with the open-ended question selected and its settings panel outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/long-text-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The open-ended question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/long-text-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Required.** Leave it off for an open comment, so a respondent with nothing to add moves on and the comments you receive are considered ones.

## Best practices for research

Ask 1 specific thing, such as what to change. Specific prompts give answers you can code, where a request for any comments gives answers that are hard to compare.

Reference: Krosnick, J. A., & Presser, S. (2010). Question and questionnaire design. In P. V. Marsden & J. D. Wright (Eds.), *Handbook of survey research* (2nd ed., pp. 263-313). Emerald.
